subject: Request: latest penetration test report & scope — Cygnus Health
messages:
From: Anita Patel <anita.patel@cygnushealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 08:12:00 -0000
Subject: Request for penetration test report and scope details

Hi Lauren,

We’re running an expedited security review for Cygnus Health following an unrelated third-party incident in our supply chain. Our security team has requested Redwood’s most recent penetration test report (or a redacted executive version), the testing scope, dates, and current remediation status.

Can you provide:
- A redacted exec summary or attestation we can share internally
- The testing vendor and dates
- Whether any findings were classified as Critical/High and the remediation status for those

This is time-sensitive for us — could you confirm whether you can deliver within 48 hours? If you prefer, we can schedule a brief call to go over technical details (security@cygnushealth.com is CC’d).

Thanks,
Anita
Anita Patel
Head of Security Operations
Cygnus Health

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Anita Patel <anita.patel@cygnushealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request for penetration test report and scope details

Hi Anita — thanks for the note and the heads-up.

Short answer: yes, we can provide a redacted executive summary and a remediation status matrix within the next 48 hours. Before we prepare the materials, quick clarifying questions so we share the right level of detail:
1) Is your request for procurement review or incident triage? (If incident triage, Marcus should join the call to address PoC-level questions.)
2) Do you need CVSS scores and vendor verification details included in the summary, or would a high-level CVSS banding suffice?

We will redact sensitive hostnames, IP addresses, and any PoCs or raw logs. We’ll include tester name (company), test window, scope boundaries (public endpoints, internal staging, etc.), and an itemized remediation status. Marcus will prepare a one-page remediation matrix; Evelyn is copied to coordinate access and the call.

I’ll get the draft to you by EOD tomorrow unless you indicate you need it sooner. If you want a synchronous call, Marcus is available tomorrow afternoon US/Eastern.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 14:33:00 -0000
Subject: FW: Request for penetration test report and scope details

Lauren / Evelyn — copying my notes for the redacted deliverable. Mailing this from my inbox so Anita gets a clear single response from the account team.

Summary of the most recent engagement:
- Vendor: SecureWave Labs (third-party).
- Test window: 2026-02-10 to 2026-02-17.
- Scope: public API endpoints, web console (SaaS), auth flows, session management, and selected cloud-native infra components (no on-prem customer environments). Staging environments were in-scope but with limited data.
- Severity at time of test: 0 Critical, 1 High, 3 Medium, 5 Low.
- High finding: privilege escalation path in service orchestration (disclosed as non-exploitable on production due to runtime guardrails).
- Remediation status: the High finding was remediated and deployed to production 2026-03-10; internal validation completed 2026-03-18. Medium/Low items have mitigation timelines in our remediation matrix.

Redaction policy we will apply:
- Remove IP addresses, internal hostnames, and any PoC exploit code.
- Replace specific resource identifiers with generic labels (e.g., [internal-host-1]).
- Keep CVSS scores, executive summaries, and remediation status for each finding.

Deliverables we can provide:
1) pen_test_executive_summary_redacted.pdf — executive summary, scope, dates, vendor, severity summary, remediation status.
2) remediation_matrix.csv — find ID, severity, remediation status, owner, remediation date (if remediated), retest scheduled.
3) Attestation letter confirming no critical findings and that remediation for the High finding was validated on 2026-03-18.

Caveats: we will not share raw logs, PoCs, or red-team command outputs. If Cygnus requires PoCs for internal validation, we will require an NDA amendment and a controlled disclosure call.

I’ll prepare the two artifacts and send to Lauren for review; happy to join a technical call if Anita’s team needs to validate specifics.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Security Engineer, Platform Security
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Anita Patel <anita.patel@cygnushealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: security@cygnushealth.com
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 09:10:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request for penetration test report and scope details

Thanks, Lauren and Marcus — this is helpful.

For context: this started as a procurement-level checklist but was escalated after our SOC team saw anomalous activity tied to a vendor on March 17. We need the redacted executive summary and remediation matrix as soon as possible; the attestation will help our internal change-review board.

Two asks:
- Please include CVSS scores in the redacted summary and the remediation matrix columns.
- Can Marcus be available for a 30-minute call tomorrow (Tue) at 15:00 US/Eastern to walk through the High finding validation? If that slot works, we’ll send calendar invite.

If you can send the docs ahead of the call, that would be ideal.

Regards,
Anita

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Anita Patel <anita.patel@cygnushealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 11:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request for penetration test report and scope details

Hi Anita — attached are the materials we discussed.

Attachments: 
- pen_test_executive_summary_redacted.pdf (executive summary, scope, vendor, dates, CVSS bands and scores)
- remediation_matrix.csv (find_id,severity,cvss_score,status,owner,remediation_date,retest_date)
- attestation_letter_signed.pdf (signed attestation: no critical findings; High finding remediated and validated 2026-03-18)

Per Marcus: we have redacted IPs/hostnames and removed PoC details. Marcus will join the call at 15:00 US/Eastern today to discuss the High finding validation. If you need the original, unredacted artifacts for an internal regulator review, please let us know and we can discuss an NDA amendment and controlled disclosure process.

Next steps: Evelyn will coordinate the calendar invite and share the Drive link to the two artifacts. Let us know if you need any additional items (SOC 2 cover letter, SIG questionnaire crosswalk).

Best regards,
